# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------
source("Analysis.R")

# DGP2, correct spec, p = 50, s × decay × covcor grid, overlap = 1, 1000 reps
df_sphp   <- load_sim("../results/sparsityE6DGP2.csv.gz")
summ_sphp <- summarise_sim(df_sphp) |>
  mutate(sf = factor(s, sort(unique(s))))

# AR(1) covariance arm, same grid
df_sphp_ar1   <- load_sim("../results/sparsityE6ar1DGP2.csv.gz")
summ_sphp_ar1 <- summarise_sim(df_sphp_ar1) |>
  mutate(sf = factor(s, sort(unique(s))))

# reps per cell (ar1 arm was incomplete at last check)
table(summ_sphp_ar1$m)

```

# decay 1

```{r}
dfm <- filter(summ_sphp, decay == 1)   # flip decay for the 0.5 tab
sphp_extra <- list(
  facet_wrap(~p, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(p = \(x) paste0("p = ", x))),
  labs(x = "s"))

# RMSE | |Bias| vs s, faceted by p
print(panel(dfm, "linear", x = sf, extra = sphp_extra))

# bal0 vs oracle
print(panel(dfm, "linear", x = sf,
            ests = c("balnet0", "oracle_hajek", "oracle_ht"),
            extra = sphp_extra))

#- table -#
perf_table(dfm, cols = c("p", "s"),
           span_lab = \(x) paste0("p = ", x), span_desc = FALSE,
           group = "outcome",
           title = "High-p sparsity, iid, decay = 1 (n = 1000, c = 1)")

#- MSE decomp -#
print(decomp_plot(dfm, x = s, cols = p, xlab = "s",
                  x_scale = scale_x_log10(breaks = c(4, 16, 64, 256)),
                  title = paste("MSE Decomposition (%) \u2014", oc_labs["linear"])))

#- extreme estimates -#
extreme_heat(dfm, "glmnetcv_hajek", x = s, xlab = "s", x_desc = FALSE)
```
